productRole: Inline 2D hillshade and true-elevation 3D mesh for terrain form inspection; not flood depth, risk classification or surveyed design levels.

source.noData: alpha 0; preserve transparent, no fallback or zero substitution
source.unit_basis: Terrain consumer elevation convention/UI; manifest does not have a standalone unit field
source.resolution_basis: FABDEM V1-2 publisher; not a claim of new survey precision from tile zoom

scope.name_th: เมืองขอนแก่น

source.attribution: FABDEM V1-2 (Hawker et al. 2022, University of Bristol), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
source.external3DSelectionNote: District route verified; select FABDEM in the upstream UI if not already selected. d=terrain alone does not prove source selection.

legend.th: เงาภูมิประเทศจาก FABDEM — แสงช่วยเห็นรูปทรง ไม่ใช่สีระดับความสูงหรือความเสี่ยง
legend.en: FABDEM terrain shading — relief lighting, not elevation or risk colours
legend.overzoom_th: ต้นทางประมาณ 30 ม.; การซูมใกล้ขยายภาพเดิม ไม่เพิ่มรายละเอียด

source.external3DFieldsRole: Retained source metadata/provenance only; primary UI uses inline3D rather than navigating to this route.

scope.renderRule: FABDEM district4001 only. 2D clips raster; 3D omits no-data cells and every native cell touched by the district boundary, leaving a conservative empty edge band. No terrain is generated outside verified coverage.
scope.mapFilterMeaning: Map scope and village boundaries remain context; no new demographic or flood aggregation.

runtimeCatalog.rule: Override only in memory when both approved terrain metadata files load; retain historical catalogue bytes.

display.mapInstance: Persistent Leaflet 2D plus inline MapLibre6.12 3D controller, shared geographic camera; no iframe or external3D navigation.
display.legend: neutral hillshade, no numerical elevation domain
display.missingValue: alpha0 → geometry absent; never zero or RGB-only native DEM decoding
display.outsideCoverage: No mesh; ordinary basemap remains context only.
display.sourceFailure: Keep 2D usable while3D loads; failed3D restores2D with a retry action.

limitations: Vertical datum, vertical accuracy and survey acquisition date remain unknown.
Tile build date2026-10-07 is not survey acquisition date.
CC BY-NC-SA4.0 stated in source; commercial permission not verified.
Display zoom22 enlarges source pixels; native resolution remains approximately30m.
The 3D view does not add detail to the approximately30m source.
A conservative unrendered band may remain at district boundaries or unavailable neighbouring samples.
Projective basemap texture support and real rendering must be verified separately; a fallback is not new elevation data.
3D shows terrain and selected boundary context; GIS record inspection remains in2D.

modes.dataset: terrain only; nonterrain and unsupported values use2d

camera.sceneNavigationBounds: District4001 bounding box plus0.15degrees context margin; entering from outside this extent can constrain the3D camera.

modes.contextOverlays: Available in2D; disabled with explanation in3D. Existing selection retained.

status.basemapReadiness: MapLibre isStyleLoaded() && areTilesLoaded(), refreshed by idle; mesh readiness does not imply basemap tiles are ready.
status.fallback: First valid mesh may appear while basemap is loading; neutral surface is explicit fallback. Fatal3D failure restores2D with retry.

mesh.pixelRegistration: Cellcentres: (pixelIndex+0.5)/256 within native tile. Query sampling follows same grid.
mesh.neighbourStitch: Connect only available, alpha-valid neighbouring source samples. Unavailable border support remains an empty strip.
mesh.boundaryPolicy: Conservative whole-cell omission; no boundary-crossing triangles or filled holes.
mesh.nodataPolicy: No geometry through alpha0/missing samples; no extrapolation to zero.
mesh.precision: Tile-local Mercator origin; latitude-specific metre conversion.
mesh.basemap: Current-frame projective reprojection when available; neutral surface for offscreen/failed texture support.
mesh.lighting: Neutral relief shading with normalized local vector[-0.5,-0.5,1]; does not encode elevation or flood risk.
